description: This file defines the NotesViewModel class, which manages note data for a notes application. It provides functions to refresh, search, add, update, and delete notes, interfacing with the NotesRepository.

classes.name: NotesViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel class responsible for handling note data and operations for the notes app frontend.

methods.name: refreshNotes
methods.description: Fetches all notes from the repository and updates the LiveData.

methods.name: searchNotes
methods.description: Filters notes based on the search query and updates the LiveData accordingly.

methods.name: addNote
methods.description: Adds a new note to the repository and refreshes the notes list.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note in the repository and refreshes the list.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note by its ID from the repository and refreshes the list.
